description: Candidate for eslint-plugin-n 18.4.1 n/hashbang: reports every shebang line ("This file needs no shebang."). Upstream decides per file whether a shebang is required from the nearest package.json's `bin` (convertPath, npmignore and additionalExecutables included) and also reports a missing or non-node shebang, BOM and CRLF in bin files; Rerail cannot read package.json, so bin files are FPs (shebang present) and FNs (shebang missing).
